purpose: Final Dallas release-candidate gate before team completion. Validate that the complete 53-player Gamecast chibi library behaves as one coherent production asset set under authoritative live-play truth without relaxing visual identity, animation, signature, or cross-sport isolation rules.

rosterIdentity: Exactly 53 roster identities must resolve through the Dallas roster snapshot and player namespaces with no duplicate slug or cross-player alias.

Uniform number displayed by an asset must agree with the roster-authoritative player identity; stale-number assets fail closed to a safe generic Dallas presentation rather than displaying the wrong player.

Personalized appearance assets are eligible only when their appearance-reference provenance is locked to a current official headshot; skin tone or visible appearance is never inferred from name or roster metadata.
visualContinuity: Approved realistic 3D chibi proportions, camera angle, lighting direction, scale, transparent background, and canonical foot anchor remain invariant across idle, action, celebration, recovery, resize, reconnect, and reduced-motion paths.
Transparent edges must remain clean at production compositing scale with no matte halo, opaque rectangle, clipped extremity, or ground-anchor jump.
A player returning from any action or celebration must recover to the same canonical anchor and scale used before the sequence.
gamecastTruth: Authoritative play identity and revision supersede cached or previously rendered event state.
Repeated polling of an unchanged play is idempotent and cannot restart an animation or celebration.
Late asset decode, background-tab resume, reconnect, viewport resize, or stale promise completion cannot resurrect a superseded play.
Only one football owner is visually authoritative at a time; ownership transfers or clears deterministically when play truth changes.
Missing, malformed, stale, or ineligible personalized assets degrade locally without blocking Gamecast or substituting another player's likeness.

signatures.eligibility: Authoritative play credits CeeDee Lamb with the qualifying first down and the verified signature asset is available.
signatures.correctionRule: Immediately preempt if authoritative correction removes Lamb, removes the first down, or changes the credited player.

signatures.eligibility: Authoritative play credits Von Miller with the qualifying sack and the verified signature asset is available.
signatures.correctionRule: Immediately preempt if authoritative correction removes Miller, removes the sack, or changes the credited player.

releaseGate.signaturePolicy: No other Dallas animation may be labeled or routed as a named player-specific signature without verified source-backed metadata.
releaseGate.isolation: Dallas chibi QA and runtime metadata remain under the NFL/DAL asset namespace and must not alter MLB or NHL rendering, routing, polling, Gamecast state, or asset behavior.

acceptanceFixtures.expect: Every roster identity resolves uniquely to its own Dallas player namespace and roster-authoritative action inventory.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: appearance provenance failure for one player
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Only that player's personalized likeness is suppressed; no inferred appearance or teammate substitution occurs.
Wrong-number personalized asset is rejected and safe fallback preserves correct event identity.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: rapid pass-catch-tackle-first-down sequence with repeated polls
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Actions advance once in authoritative order, football ownership is singular, and unchanged polls do not replay frames.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: CeeDee Lamb qualifying first down followed by authoritative correction
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Nose-wipe may begin only for the qualifying Lamb event and is preempted immediately after correction.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: Von Miller qualifying sack followed by authoritative correction
acceptanceFixtures.expect: DeSoto Shuffle may begin only for the qualifying Miller sack and is preempted immediately after correction.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: invented or unverified named celebration request
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Named-signature routing is rejected; ordinary event-appropriate celebration/fallback remains available.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: late decode from superseded play after new play starts
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Late result is discarded and cannot steal participant, football, anchor, or animation authority.

acceptanceFixtures.scenario: resize plus background-tab resume during contact sequence
acceptanceFixtures.expect: Players reproject without identity swap, clipping, scale drift, anchor jump, or duplicate animation restart.
Same authoritative event/player/signature eligibility decisions are preserved while motion is reduced.
No opaque backgrounds, edge halos, clipped limbs/equipment, or inconsistent ground contacts appear across representative offensive, defensive, and special-teams actions.
No MLB or NHL files, routes, polling behavior, Gamecast state, or asset namespaces are changed by this Dallas QA batch.

completionCriteria: All 53 Dallas identities pass namespace, number, appearance-provenance, action-inventory, anchor, alpha, and deterministic playback gates.
CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe and Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle remain the only verified named Dallas signature concepts.
Corrections, repeated polling, late decode, reconnect, resize, resume, and reduced-motion paths preserve authoritative event truth.
No MLB/NHL behavior or files are modified.
